$schema_note: Hub-store SLICE of the Project-Identity Completeness Gate SSOT. CANONICAL source is PB scripts/db/project_identity_surfaces.json; this file is the Hub-committed copy so the Hub CI job (scripts/check-project-identity-gate.py, wired in .github/workflows/schema-drift.yml) can run WITHOUT a PB checkout. The hub_d1 surfaces + keep_slug_kg_nodes + kg_namespace + known_residues.hub_d1 here MUST stay byte-equal to the PB canonical — enforced by PB tests/db/test_project_identity_gate.py::test_hub_copy_matches_pb_hub_slice. North-star + decision: PB Context/Decisions/2026-06-05-project-identity-single-machine-identity.md.

policies.typed_required: Live machine/identity path. The STORED value MUST be a typed proj_* PK (or NULL). The browser read may PRESENT a slug, but storage is asserted typed. Any non-typed stored value is a HARD FAILURE.
policies.exempt_display_mirror: Append-only, read-only mirror of a Hub presentation field. Not a machine-routing FK. Exempt from typed assertion; documented, not failed.
policies.exempt_historical: Append-only forensic / analytics / audit surface. Default LEAVE. Non-typed legacy values are EXPECTED. Reported as informational, never a hard failure.
policies.keep_slug_kg: The documented 5 KEEP slug-form kg nodes. Exempt from the slug-form kg assertion. ANY slug-form active project: kg node OUTSIDE this set is a HARD FAILURE.

kg_namespace.note: project:* is a DUAL-USE kg namespace. Most slug-suffix nodes are extractor GARBAGE (project:hub.py, project:/process, file paths) — NOT identity surfaces. The gate's kg assertions scope to ACTIVE nodes/relations only. A node is a typed project node iff id LIKE 'project:proj_%'. An ACTIVE slug-form project node (id LIKE 'project:%' AND NOT LIKE 'project:proj_%') is a FAILURE unless in keep_slug_kg.
kg_namespace.slug_node_pattern_active: id LIKE 'project:%' AND id NOT LIKE 'project:proj_%'

known_residues.$note: Pre-identified defects the gate FOUND that are tracked for a follow-up fix but are NOT this slice's remit (Slice E builds the gate; Slice A owns kg reconciliation). Each entry downgrades that EXACT finding from hard-fail to WARN. Remove the entry when the fix lands; the gate then hard-fails on any regression. Anything NOT listed here stays fail-closed.

dangling_rel_missing_node.remedy: Slice A follow-up: MINT the missing canonical kg node on Hub (the project IS live; brain.db already has the node — pure per-store propagation gap), then drop this entry. Resurrect-safe additive mint, zero-risk.

introspection.rule: Every %project%id% column discovered on Hub D1 via sqlite_master/pragma MUST appear in surfaces.hub_d1. Any column NOT listed is an UNKNOWN SURFACE = HARD FAILURE (fail-closed).
